title: The Shortcut
scene: You are walking to meet a friend when your phone suggests a faster route. The shortcut leads you through unfamiliar streets, a confused map, and finally a closed path, leaving you later than if you had stayed on the main road.
sceneJa: 友人との待ち合わせに向かう途中、スマホが7分短縮できる近道を提案する。知らない住宅街や方向感覚のズレ、通行止めに振り回され、結局は大通りへ戻って予定より遅れて到着する。

chunks.en: I was walking to meet a friend
chunks.ja: 友人との待ち合わせに向かって歩いていると
スマホが提案してきた

chunks.en: a route I had never taken before.
chunks.ja: 今まで通ったことのないルートを

chunks.en: It was supposed to save me seven minutes,
chunks.ja: 7分短縮できるはずで
試す価値はありそうだった

chunks.en: since I was already running slightly late.
chunks.ja: すでに少し遅れ気味だったので

chunks.en: The route took me off the main road
chunks.ja: そのルートは大通りを外れ

chunks.en: and through a quiet residential area
chunks.ja: 静かな住宅街へ私を連れていき
そこではどの道も
安心するほど似て見えた
何度か曲がるうちに

chunks.en: the blue dot on the map
chunks.ja: 地図上の青い点が
動かなくなったように見えた

chunks.en: in the same direction as me.
chunks.ja: 私と同じ方向へ
私はその場で2回ほど向きを変えた

chunks.en: to help my phone work out
chunks.ja: スマホに判断してもらうために
自分がどちらを向いているかを

chunks.en: which also helped a nearby resident notice me.
chunks.ja: ついでに近くの住民にも私の存在を認識してもらえた
ようやく
正しい道を見つけ
歩く速度を上げた

chunks.en: to make up for lost time.
chunks.ja: 失った時間を取り戻すために
するとルートは私を導いた

chunks.en: to a narrow set of stairs
chunks.ja: 細い階段へ
そこには看板があり
道が一時的に通行止めだと書かれていた

chunks.en: I stood there for a moment
chunks.ja: 私はしばらくそこに立ち
地図を見ていた
まるでどちらかが
状況を考え直すかもしれないかのように
結局

chunks.en: I went back to the main road
chunks.ja: 大通りまで戻り
12分遅れて到着した
当初の予定より

chunks.en: My friend asked why I was late,
chunks.ja: 友人に遅れた理由を聞かれ
私は彼に答えた
時間を節約していたのだと
厳密に言えば
その近道は完璧に機能していた
まさにその時までは
私が実際に使おうとするまでは

questions.question: Which boundary is most natural?
options: It was supposed to save me seven minutes / which seemed worth trying / since I was already running slightly late
It was supposed / to save me seven / minutes which seemed / worth trying since I was already running slightly late
It was / supposed to save me / seven minutes which seemed worth / trying since I was already running slightly late
questions.explanation: The first chunk gives the expected result, the second evaluates it, and the third explains why the speaker was willing to try it.

questions.question: What does ‘make up for lost time’ mean here?
options: Move faster to recover time lost earlier
Take a break because you are already late
questions.explanation: ‘Make up for lost time’ means trying to recover time that has already been lost, usually by moving or working faster.

questions.question: Why is the last sentence funny?
options: Because the shortcut was only useful in theory, before the speaker actually tried to take it
Because the friend had secretly changed the route
Because the speaker arrived seven minutes early
questions.explanation: The joke is that the shortcut appears perfect only until reality tests it. The speaker describes failure in an overly technical, calm way.

speak: Start with mild optimism. Let the rhythm become slightly more hesitant through the residential streets and the confused map. Read ‘I had been saving time’ very matter-of-factly, then deliver the final sentence calmly and dryly, with a small pause after ‘Technically.’
review: Yesterday’s lesson was about being overly careful with a coffee and then causing the problem yourself. Today shifts from physical awkwardness to decision-making: a sensible-looking shortcut creates the delay it was meant to avoid. Useful chunks are ‘be supposed to,’ ‘make up for lost time,’ and ‘right up until.’
